title: a2a-rust lineage extension v1: the value under Message.metadata["a2a-rust.com/lineage"] and Task.metadata["a2a-rust.com/lineage"]
description: Which job a task belongs to (root), how far down the job's tree it is (depth), and optionally the delegating task (parentTaskId). Unknown members are ignored. The rule 'parentTaskId requires depth >= 1' is expressed below; 'at most 1024 bytes' is in UTF-8 bytes, which maxLength (in characters) cannot express, so a receiver also checks the byte length.
